bones.contract: 24: root, body, a four-segment spine, neck, head, four stilt chains

fin_array.note: one component per fin so the runtime can light them in sequence

small_head.contract: carried high, no fight in the silhouette

creator: Angelis Pseftis

detection_readout.addressing: one component per fin, ordered along the spine, so the runtime can light them in sequence
detection_readout.note: The state assemblies show all-dark and all-lit only. The ordered sequence toward a source is a per-fin MATERIAL animation and is not represented in geometry.

foot_planting.why: Long stilts magnify any rotation at the hip, so each foot is counter-rotated by the negation of everything above it and the residual is removed by raising the body. The lifts are MEASURED on the posed mesh, not dialled in by eye.

gait_separation.note: This one shares the Riftstalker's diagonal pattern; its separation is carried by proportion and the fin array, not by the gait.
gait_separation.resonant: a quick small-stride diagonal gait at 470 cm/s, almost silent

material_slot_policy: Two slots: dark faceted plate for the torso, spine, stilts and head, and amber for the translucent sensor fins, which are the only emissive. The fins carry a translucency mask in texture.

rig.policy: The corrected card's plan: a slender quadruped with a four-segment spine carrying the fin array, weighted toward the spine and neck rather than the limbs — the inverse of the Cairnback's weighting. No root motion.

silhouette_first.this_asset: The third Kharuun quadruped, so it must separate from BOTH the others. Its own separation is that it is taller than it is long, which neither of them is.
